textTouch: Tap your player seal to clap.
notes: Waiting on the touch and pad wordings — the two lorem cells, not `text`, which is yours. `{clap}` resolves to whatever clap is bound to, and that is a key nobody holding a phone or a pad has. On a pad the token to use is `{faceLeft}`, which becomes that controller's left face button (the salute row in callouts.csv is the same line in the same shape). On touch there is no clap button at all — you tap the seal itself, see CONFIG.touch.clap. One sentence each, about as long as the keyboard line, read cold on the loading screen. Or type kbm into `devices` and the row is a keyboard tip on purpose.
